title: ３Ｄ－ＣＡＤ
subtitle: 3D - CAD
teachers:
MORIYOSHI Takahiro
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)learn the fundamentals of 3D-CAD systems
(2)learn the skills to handle 3D-CAD systems as aircraft design tool
(3)learn how CAD is used in aircraft design and manufacturing
advice:
In this course, students will learn the 3D-CAD system, which supports engineers in design and manufacture. We will cover the following materials:
1. Computational design used for the aircraft design and manufacturing process
2. CAD/CAM/CAE systems
3. 3D part modeling
4. Assembly modeling
5. Additive Manufacturing

Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves.
Students should not be late or absent from the class.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Mechanical Drawing I and II.

activityGoals.body: Be able to describe computer usage in an aircraft manufacturing process
Be able to describe the role of the CAD system in an aircraft manufacturing process
Be able to design a part model based on design logic by using CAD modeling
Be able to design an assembly model by making use of the assembly function
Be able to print parts that can be assembled using a 3D printer

(1) Describe the role of CAD/CAM/CAE in an aircraft design and manufacturing process
(2) Design a part model based on design logic using 3D CAD modeling
(3) Assemble a final shape under adequate constraints by using the 3D CAD assembly function
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the usage of CAD/CAM/CAE in an aircraft design and manufacturing process
(2) Design a part model by using 3D CAD modeling
(3) Assemble final shapes by using the 3D CAD assembly function

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will learn the 3D-CAD system, which supports engineers in design and manufacture. We will cover the following materials:
1. Computational design used for the aircraft design and manufacturing process
2. CAD/CAM/CAE systems
3. 3D part modeling
4. Assembly modeling
5. Additive Manufacturing

Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves.
Students should not be late or absent from the class.
